Chengdong Pan (潘承洞)

Peking University

A close relation of the Top 100: not in the algorithmic ranking by publication count, but placed in the immediate orbit of canonical Goldbach researchers by the Mathematics Genealogy Project's advisor-student network.

Google ScholarSearch results
Close-relation rank6 of 6
PhD year1961
UniversityPeking University
Lifespan1934-1997
Network proximity (PPR score)0.00430

One of the founders of the Chinese school of Goldbach research and a student of Hua Luogeng. He did major work on the Goldbach problem through the 1960s and 1970s.
